020package com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api;
021
022import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.grammar.java.JavaLanguageLexer;
023
024/**
025 * Contains the constants for all the tokens contained in the Abstract Syntax Tree.
026 *
027 * <p>Implementation detail: This class has been introduced to break
028 * the circular dependency between packages.</p>
029 *
030 * @noinspection ClassWithTooManyDependents
031 * @noinspectionreason ClassWithTooManyDependents - this class is a core part of our API
032 */
033public final class TokenTypes {
034
035    /**
036     * This is the root node for the source file.  It's children
037     * are an optional package definition, zero or more import statements,
038     * and zero or more type declarations.
039     *
040     * <p>For example:</p>
041     * {@snippet :
042     * import java.util.List;
043     *
044     * class MyClass{}
045     * interface MyInterface{}
046     * ;
047     * }
048     *
049     * <p>parses as:</p>
050     *
051     * {@snippet :
052     * COMPILATION_UNIT -> COMPILATION_UNIT
053     * |--IMPORT -> import
054     * |   |--DOT -> .
055     * |   |   |--DOT -> .
056     * |   |   |   |--IDENT -> java
057     * |   |   |   `--IDENT -> util
058     * |   |   `--IDENT -> List
059     * |   `--SEMI -> ;
060     * |--CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF
061     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
062     * |   |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
063     * |   |--IDENT -> MyClass
064     * |   `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
065     * |       |--LCURLY -> {
066     * |       `--RCURLY -> }
067     * |--INTERFACE_DEF -> INTERFACE_DEF
068     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
069     * |   |--LITERAL_INTERFACE -> interface
070     * |   |--IDENT -> MyInterface
071     * |   `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
072     * |       |--LCURLY -> {
073     * |       `--RCURLY -> }
074     * `--SEMI -> ;
075     * }
076     *
077     * @see #PACKAGE_DEF
078     * @see #IMPORT
079     * @see #CLASS_DEF
080     * @see #INTERFACE_DEF
081     * @see #RECORD_DEF
082     * @see #ANNOTATION_DEF
083     * @see #ENUM_DEF
084     */
085    public static final int COMPILATION_UNIT = JavaLanguageLexer.COMPILATION_UNIT;
086
087    /**
088     * The root of an AST for a JEP 512 (JDK 25) compact source file. This node
089     * replaces {@link #COMPILATION_UNIT} as the root when the source file declares
090     * any top-level method or field. It represents a {@code CompactCompilationUnit},
091     * which is one of the three mutually exclusive compilation-unit
092     * forms ({@code OrdinaryCompilationUnit}, {@code CompactCompilationUnit},
093     * {@code ModularCompilationUnit}). Import declarations and top-level members
094     * appear as direct children of this node. Compact source files cannot declare a package.
095     *
096     * <p>For example:</p>
097     * {@snippet :
098     * import java.util.List;
099     *
100     * int counter = 3;
101     * void main() {}
102     * }
103     *
104     * <p>parses as:</p>
105     * {@snippet :
106     * COMPACT_COMPILATION_UNIT -> COMPACT_COMPILATION_UNIT
107     * |--IMPORT -> import
108     * |   |--DOT -> .
109     * |   |   |--DOT -> .
110     * |   |   |   |--IDENT -> java
111     * |   |   |   `--IDENT -> util
112     * |   |   `--IDENT -> List
113     * |   `--SEMI -> ;
114     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
115     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
116     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
117     * |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
118     * |   |--IDENT -> counter
119     * |   |--ASSIGN -> =
120     * |   |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
121     * |   |       `--NUM_INT -> 3
122     * |   `--SEMI -> ;
123     * `--METHOD_DEF -> METHOD_DEF
124     *     |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
125     *     |--TYPE -> TYPE
126     *     |   `--LITERAL_VOID -> void
127     *     |--IDENT -> main
128     *     |--LPAREN -> (
129     *     |--PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
130     *     |--RPAREN -> )
131     *     `--SLIST -> {
132     *         `--RCURLY -> }
133     * }
134     *
135     * @see <a href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/512">JEP 512: Compact Source Files
136     *     and Instance Main Methods</a>
137     * @see #COMPILATION_UNIT
138     */
139    public static final int COMPACT_COMPILATION_UNIT =
140            JavaLanguageLexer.COMPACT_COMPILATION_UNIT;
141
142    /**
143     * Modifiers for type, method, and field declarations.  The
144     * modifiers element is always present even though it may have no children.
145     *
146     * <p>For example:</p>
147     * {@snippet :
148     * public int x;
149     * }
150     *
151     * <p>parses as:</p>
152     * {@snippet :
153     * VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
154     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
155     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
156     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
157     *  |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
158     *  |--IDENT -> x
159     *  `--SEMI -> ;
160     * }
161     *
162     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html">Java
163     *     Language Specification, &sect;8</a>
164     * @see #LITERAL_PUBLIC
165     * @see #LITERAL_PROTECTED
166     * @see #LITERAL_PRIVATE
167     * @see #ABSTRACT
168     * @see #LITERAL_STATIC
169     * @see #FINAL
170     * @see #LITERAL_TRANSIENT
171     * @see #LITERAL_VOLATILE
172     * @see #LITERAL_SYNCHRONIZED
173     * @see #LITERAL_NATIVE
174     * @see #STRICTFP
175     * @see #ANNOTATION
176     * @see #LITERAL_DEFAULT
177     */
178    public static final int MODIFIERS = JavaLanguageLexer.MODIFIERS;
179
180    /**
181     * An object block.  These are children of class, interface, enum,
182     * annotation and enum constant declarations.
183     * Also, object blocks are children of the new keyword when defining anonymous inner types.
184     *
185     * <p>For example:</p>
186     * {@snippet :
187     * class Test {}
188     * }
189     *
190     * <p>parses as:</p>
191     * {@snippet :
192     * CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF
193     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
194     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
195     * |--IDENT -> Test
196     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
197     *     |--LCURLY -> {
198     *     `--RCURLY -> }
199     * }
200     *
201     * @see #LCURLY
202     * @see #INSTANCE_INIT
203     * @see #STATIC_INIT
204     * @see #CLASS_DEF
205     * @see #CTOR_DEF
206     * @see #METHOD_DEF
207     * @see #VARIABLE_DEF
208     * @see #RCURLY
209     * @see #INTERFACE_DEF
210     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
211     * @see #ENUM_DEF
212     * @see #ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
213     * @see #ANNOTATION_DEF
214     */
215    public static final int OBJBLOCK = JavaLanguageLexer.OBJBLOCK;
216    /**
217     * A list of statements.
218     *
219     * <p>For example:</p>
220     * {@snippet :
221     * if (c == 1) {
222     *     c = 0;
223     * }
224     * }
225     *
226     * <p>parses as:</p>
227     * {@snippet :
228     * LITERAL_IF -> if
229     *  |--LPAREN -> (
230     *  |--EXPR -> EXPR
231     *  |   `--EQUAL -> ==
232     *  |       |--IDENT -> c
233     *  |       `--NUM_INT -> 1
234     *  |--RPAREN -> )
235     *  `--SLIST -> {
236     *      |--EXPR -> EXPR
237     *      |   `--ASSIGN -> =
238     *      |       |--IDENT -> c
239     *      |       `--NUM_INT -> 0
240     *      |--SEMI -> ;
241     *      `--RCURLY -> }
242     * }
243     *
244     * @see #RCURLY
245     * @see #EXPR
246     * @see #LABELED_STAT
247     * @see #LITERAL_THROWS
248     * @see #LITERAL_RETURN
249     * @see #SEMI
250     * @see #METHOD_DEF
251     * @see #CTOR_DEF
252     * @see #LITERAL_FOR
253     * @see #LITERAL_WHILE
254     * @see #LITERAL_IF
255     * @see #LITERAL_ELSE
256     * @see #CASE_GROUP
257     */
258    public static final int SLIST = JavaLanguageLexer.SLIST;
259    /**
260     * A constructor declaration.
261     *
262     * <p>For example:</p>
263     * {@snippet :
264     * public SpecialEntry(int value, String text)
265     * {
266     *   this.value = value;
267     *   this.text = text;
268     * }
269     * }
270     *
271     * <p>parses as:</p>
272     * {@snippet :
273     * CTOR_DEF -> CTOR_DEF
274     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
275     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
276     *  |--IDENT -> SpecialEntry
277     *  |--LPAREN -> (
278     *  |--PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
279     *  |   |--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
280     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
281     *  |   |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
282     *  |   |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
283     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> value
284     *  |   |--COMMA -> ,
285     *  |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
286     *  |       |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
287     *  |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
288     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> String
289     *  |       `--IDENT -> text
290     *  |--RPAREN -> )
291     *  `--SLIST -> {
292     *      |--EXPR -> EXPR
293     *      |   `--ASSIGN -> =
294     *      |       |--DOT -> .
295     *      |   |--LITERAL_THIS -> this
296     *      |       |   `--IDENT -> value
297     *      |       `--IDENT -> value
298     *      |--SEMI -> ;
299     *      |--EXPR -> EXPR
300     *      |   `--ASSIGN -> =
301     *      |       |--DOT -> .
302     *      |       |   |--LITERAL_THIS -> this
303     *      |       |   `--IDENT -> text
304     *      |       `--IDENT -> text
305     *      |--SEMI -> ;
306     *      `--RCURLY -> }
307     * }
308     *
309     * @see #OBJBLOCK
310     * @see #CLASS_DEF
311     */
312    public static final int CTOR_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.CTOR_DEF;
313    /**
314     * A method declaration.  The children are modifiers, type parameters,
315     * return type, method name, parameter list, an optional throws list, and
316     * statement list.  The statement list is omitted if the method
317     * declaration appears in an interface declaration.  Method
318     * declarations may appear inside object blocks of class
319     * declarations, interface declarations, enum declarations,
320     * enum constant declarations or anonymous inner-class declarations.
321     *
322     * <p>For example:</p>
323     *
324     * {@snippet :
325     *  public static int square(int x)
326     *  {
327     *    return x*x;
328     *  }
329     * }
330     *
331     * <p>parses as:</p>
332     *
333     * {@snippet :
334     * --METHOD_DEF -> METHOD_DEF
335     *    |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
336     *    |   |--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
337     *    |   `--LITERAL_STATIC -> static
338     *    |--TYPE -> TYPE
339     *    |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
340     *    |--IDENT -> square
341     *    |--LPAREN -> (
342     *    |--PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
343     *    |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
344     *    |       |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
345     *    |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
346     *    |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
347     *    |       `--IDENT -> x
348     *    |--RPAREN -> )
349     *    `--SLIST -> {
350     *        |--LITERAL_RETURN -> return
351     *        |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
352     *        |   |   `--STAR -> *
353     *        |   |       |--IDENT -> x
354     *        |   |       `--IDENT -> x
355     *        |   `--SEMI -> ;
356     *        `--RCURLY -> }
357     * }
358     *
359     * @see #MODIFIERS
360     * @see #TYPE_PARAMETERS
361     * @see #TYPE
362     * @see #IDENT
363     * @see #PARAMETERS
364     * @see #LITERAL_THROWS
365     * @see #SLIST
366     * @see #OBJBLOCK
367     */
368    public static final int METHOD_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.METHOD_DEF;
369
370    /**
371     * A field or local variable declaration.  The children are
372     * modifiers, type, the identifier name, and an optional assignment statement.
373     *
374     * <p>For example:</p>
375     * {@snippet :
376     * final double PI = 3.14;
377     * }
378     *
379     * <p>parses as:</p>
380     * {@snippet :
381     * VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
382     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
383     *  |   `--FINAL -> final
384     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
385     *  |   `--LITERAL_DOUBLE -> double
386     *  |--IDENT -> PI
387     *  |--ASSIGN -> =
388     *  |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
389     *  |       `--NUM_FLOAT -> 3.14
390     *  `--SEMI -> ;
391     * }
392     *
393     * @see #MODIFIERS
394     * @see #TYPE
395     * @see #IDENT
396     * @see #ASSIGN
397     */
398    public static final int VARIABLE_DEF =
399        JavaLanguageLexer.VARIABLE_DEF;
400
401    /**
402     * An instance initializer.  Zero or more instance initializers
403     * may appear in class and enum definitions.  This token will be a child
404     * of the object block of the declaring type.
405     *
406     * <p>For example:</p>
407     * {@snippet :
408     * public class MyClass {
409     *     private int foo;
410     *     {foo = 10;}
411     * }
412     * }
413     *
414     * <p>parses as:</p>
415     * {@snippet :
416     * CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF
417     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
418     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
419     *  |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
420     *  |--IDENT -> MyClass
421     *  `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
422     *      |--LCURLY -> {
423     *      |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
424     *      |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
425     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_PRIVATE -> private
426     *      |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
427     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
428     *      |   |--IDENT -> foo
429     *      |   `--SEMI -> ;
430     *      |--INSTANCE_INIT -> INSTANCE_INIT
431     *      |   `--SLIST -> {
432     *      |       |--EXPR -> EXPR
433     *      |       |   `--ASSIGN -> =
434     *      |       |       |--IDENT -> foo
435     *      |       |       `--NUM_INT -> 10
436     *      |       |--SEMI -> ;
437     *      |       `--RCURLY -> }
438     *      `--RCURLY -> }
439     * }
440     *
441     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.6">Java
442     *     Language Specification&sect;8.6</a>
443     * @see #SLIST
444     * @see #OBJBLOCK
445     */
446    public static final int INSTANCE_INIT =
447        JavaLanguageLexer.INSTANCE_INIT;
448
449    /**
450     * A static initialization block.  Zero or more static
451     * initializers may be children of the object block of a class
452     * or enum declaration (interfaces cannot have static initializers).  The
453     * first and only child is a statement list.
454     *
455     * <p>For Example:</p>
456     * {@snippet :
457     * static {
458     *   num = 10;
459     * }
460     * }
461     *
462     * <p>parses as:</p>
463     * {@snippet :
464     * STATIC_INIT -> STATIC_INIT
465     *  `--SLIST -> {
466     *      |--EXPR -> EXPR
467     *      |   `--ASSIGN -> =
468     *      |       |--IDENT -> num
469     *      |       `--NUM_INT -> 10
470     *      |--SEMI -> ;
471     *      `--RCURLY -> }
472     * }
473     *
474     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.7">Java
475     *     Language Specification, &sect;8.7</a>
476     * @see #SLIST
477     * @see #OBJBLOCK
478     */
479    public static final int STATIC_INIT =
480        JavaLanguageLexer.STATIC_INIT;
481
482    /**
483     * A type.  This is either a return type of a method or a type of
484     * a variable or field.  The first child of this element is the
485     * actual type.  This may be a primitive type, an identifier, a
486     * dot which is the root of a fully qualified type, or an array of
487     * any of these. The second child may be type arguments to the type.
488     *
489     * <p>
490     * For example:
491     * {@code boolean var = true;}
492     * </p>
493     *
494     * <p>parses as:</p>
495     * {@snippet :
496     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
497     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
498     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
499     * |   |   `--LITERAL_BOOLEAN -> boolean
500     * |   |--IDENT -> var
501     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
502     * |       `--EXPR -> EXPR
503     * |           `--LITERAL_TRUE -> true
504     * |--SEMI -> ;
505     * }
506     *
507     * @see #VARIABLE_DEF
508     * @see #METHOD_DEF
509     * @see #PARAMETER_DEF
510     * @see #IDENT
511     * @see #DOT
512     * @see #LITERAL_VOID
513     * @see #LITERAL_BOOLEAN
514     * @see #LITERAL_BYTE
515     * @see #LITERAL_CHAR
516     * @see #LITERAL_SHORT
517     * @see #LITERAL_INT
518     * @see #LITERAL_FLOAT
519     * @see #LITERAL_LONG
520     * @see #LITERAL_DOUBLE
521     * @see #ARRAY_DECLARATOR
522     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENTS
523     */
524    public static final int TYPE = JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE;
525    /**
526     * A class declaration.
527     *
528     * <p>For example:</p>
529     * {@snippet :
530     * public class Test {
531     * }
532     * }
533     *
534     * <p>parses as:</p>
535     * {@snippet :
536     * CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF
537     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
538     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
539     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
540     * |--IDENT -> Test
541     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
542     *     |--LCURLY -> {
543     *     `--RCURLY -> }
544     * }
545     *
546     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html">Java
547     *     Language Specification, &sect;8</a>
548     * @see #MODIFIERS
549     * @see #IDENT
550     * @see #EXTENDS_CLAUSE
551     * @see #IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE
552     * @see #OBJBLOCK
553     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
554     */
555    public static final int CLASS_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.CLASS_DEF;
556    /**
557     * An interface declaration.
558     *
559     * <p>For example:</p>
560     *
561     * {@snippet :
562     * public interface MyInterface {
563     *
564     * }
565     * }
566     *
567     * <p>parses as:</p>
568     *
569     * {@snippet :
570     * INTERFACE_DEF -> INTERFACE_DEF
571     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
572     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
573     * |--LITERAL_INTERFACE -> interface
574     * |--IDENT -> MyInterface
575     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
576     *     |--LCURLY -> {
577     *     `--RCURLY -> }
578     * }
579     *
580     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-9.html">Java
581     *     Language Specification, &sect;9</a>
582     * @see #MODIFIERS
583     * @see #IDENT
584     * @see #EXTENDS_CLAUSE
585     * @see #OBJBLOCK
586     */
587    public static final int INTERFACE_DEF =
588        JavaLanguageLexer.INTERFACE_DEF;
589
590    /**
591     * The package declaration.  This is optional, but if it is
592     * included, then there is only one package declaration per source
593     * file and it must be the first non-comment in the file. A package
594     * declaration may be annotated in which case the annotations comes
595     * before the rest of the declaration (and are the first children).
596     *
597     * <p>For example:</p>
598     *
599     * {@snippet :
600     *   package com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api;
601     * }
602     *
603     * <p>parses as:</p>
604     *
605     * {@snippet :
606     * PACKAGE_DEF -> package
607     * |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
608     * |--DOT -> .
609     * |   |--DOT -> .
610     * |   |   |--DOT -> .
611     * |   |   |   |--DOT -> .
612     * |   |   |   |   |--IDENT -> com
613     * |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -> puppycrawl
614     * |   |   |   `--IDENT -> tools
615     * |   |   `--IDENT -> checkstyle
616     * |   `--IDENT -> api
617     * `--SEMI -> ;
618     * }
619     *
620     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.4">Java
621     *     Language Specification &sect;7.4</a>
622     * @see #DOT
623     * @see #IDENT
624     * @see #SEMI
625     * @see #ANNOTATIONS
626     * @see FullIdent
627     */
628    public static final int PACKAGE_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.PACKAGE_DEF;
629    /**
630     * An array declaration.
631     *
632     * <p>If the array declaration represents a type, then the type of
633     * the array elements is the first child.  Multidimensional arrays
634     * may be regarded as arrays of arrays.  In other words, the first
635     * child of the array declaration is another array declaration.</p>
636     *
637     * <p>For example:</p>
638     * {@snippet :
639     *   int[] x;
640     * }
641     *
642     * <p>parses as:</p>
643     * {@snippet :
644     * VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
645     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
646     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
647     *  |   |--LITERAL_INT -> int
648     *  |   `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -> [
649     *  |       `--RBRACK -> ]
650     *  |--IDENT -> x
651     *  `--SEMI -> ;
652     * }
653     *
654     * <p>The array declaration may also represent an inline array
655     * definition.  In this case, the first child will be either an
656     * expression specifying the length of the array or an array initialization block.</p>
657     *
658     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-10.html">Java
659     *     Language Specification &sect;10</a>
660     * @see #TYPE
661     * @see #ARRAY_INIT
662     */
663    public static final int ARRAY_DECLARATOR =
664        JavaLanguageLexer.ARRAY_DECLARATOR;
665
666    /**
667     * An extends clause.  This appears as part of class and interface
668     * definitions.  This element appears even if the
669     * {@code extends} keyword is not explicitly used.  The child is an optional identifier.
670     *
671     * <p>For example:</p>
672     * {@snippet :
673     * public class Test extends ArrayList {
674     * }
675     * }
676     *
677     * <p>parses as:</p>
678     * {@snippet :
679     * CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF
680     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
681     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
682     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
683     * |--IDENT -> Test
684     * |--EXTENDS_CLAUSE -> extends
685     * |   `--IDENT -> ArrayList
686     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
687     *     |--LCURLY -> {
688     *     `--RCURLY -> }
689     * }
690     *
691     * @see #IDENT
692     * @see #DOT
693     * @see #CLASS_DEF
694     * @see #INTERFACE_DEF
695     * @see FullIdent
696     */
697    public static final int EXTENDS_CLAUSE =
698        JavaLanguageLexer.EXTENDS_CLAUSE;
699
700    /**
701     * An implements clause.  This always appears in a class or enum
702     * declaration, even if there are no implemented interfaces.  The
703     * children are a comma separated list of zero or more identifiers.
704     *
705     * <p>For example:</p>
706     * {@snippet :
707     * public class MyClass implements Collection {
708     *
709     * }
710     * }
711     *
712     * <p>parses as:</p>
713     * {@snippet :
714     * CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF
715     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
716     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
717     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
718     * |--IDENT -> MyClass
719     * |--IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE -> implements
720     * |   `--IDENT -> Collection
721     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
722     *     |--LCURLY -> {
723     *     `--RCURLY -> }
724     * }
725     *
726     * @see #IDENT
727     * @see #DOT
728     * @see #COMMA
729     * @see #CLASS_DEF
730     * @see #ENUM_DEF
731     */
732    public static final int IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE =
733        JavaLanguageLexer.IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE;
734
735    /**
736     * A list of parameters to a method or constructor.  The children
737     * are zero or more parameter declarations separated by commas.
738     *
739     * <p>For example</p>
740     * {@snippet :
741     * int start, int end
742     * }
743     *
744     * <p>parses as:</p>
745     * {@snippet :
746     * PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
747     *  |--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
748     *  |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
749     *  |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
750     *  |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
751     *  |   `--IDENT -> start
752     *  |--COMMA -> ,
753     *  `--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
754     *      |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
755     *      |--TYPE -> TYPE
756     *      |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
757     *      `--IDENT -> end
758     * }
759     *
760     * @see #PARAMETER_DEF
761     * @see #COMMA
762     * @see #METHOD_DEF
763     * @see #CTOR_DEF
764     */
765    public static final int PARAMETERS = JavaLanguageLexer.PARAMETERS;
766    /**
767     * A parameter declaration. The last parameter in a list of parameters may
768     * be variable length (indicated by the ELLIPSIS child node immediately after the TYPE child).
769     *
770     * <p>For example</p>
771     * {@snippet :
772     *      void foo(SomeType SomeType.this, int firstParameter, int... secondParameter) {}
773     * }
774     *
775     * <p>parses as:</p>
776     * {@snippet :
777     * METHOD_DEF -> METHOD_DEF
778     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
779     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
780     *  |   `--LITERAL_VOID -> void
781     *  |--IDENT -> foo
782     *  |--LPAREN -> (
783     *  |--PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
784     *  |   |--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
785     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
786     *  |   |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
787     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -> SomeType
788     *  |   |   `--DOT -> .
789     *  |   |       |--IDENT -> SomeType
790     *  |   |       `--LITERAL_THIS -> this
791     *  |   |--COMMA -> ,
792     *  |   |--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
793     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
794     *  |   |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
795     *  |   |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
796     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> firstParameter
797     *  |   |--COMMA -> ,
798     *  |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
799     *  |       |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
800     *  |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
801     *  |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
802     *  |       |--ELLIPSIS -> ...
803     *  |       `--IDENT -> secondParameter
804     *  |--RPAREN -> )
805     *  `--SLIST -> {
806     *      `--RCURLY -> }
807     *
808     * }
809     *
810     * @see #MODIFIERS
811     * @see #TYPE
812     * @see #IDENT
813     * @see #PARAMETERS
814     * @see #ELLIPSIS
815     */
816    public static final int PARAMETER_DEF =
817        JavaLanguageLexer.PARAMETER_DEF;
818
819    /**
820     * A labeled statement.
821     *
822     * <p>For example:</p>
823     * {@snippet :
824     * outer:
825     * while (i < 10) {
826     *     if (i == 5)
827     *         continue outer;
828     *     i++;
829     * }
830     * }
831     *
832     * <p>parses as:</p>
833     * {@snippet :
834     * LABELED_STAT -> :
835     *  |--IDENT -> outer
836     *  `--LITERAL_WHILE -> while
837     *      |--LPAREN -> (
838     *      |--EXPR -> EXPR
839     *      |   `--LT -> <
840     *      |       |--IDENT -> i
841     *      |       `--NUM_INT -> 10
842     *      |--RPAREN -> )
843     *      `--SLIST -> {
844     *          |--LITERAL_IF -> if
845     *          |   |--LPAREN -> (
846     *          |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
847     *          |   |   `--EQUAL -> ==
848     *          |   |       |--IDENT -> i
849     *          |   |       `--NUM_INT -> 5
850     *          |   |--RPAREN -> )
851     *          |   `--LITERAL_CONTINUE -> continue
852     *          |       |--IDENT -> outer
853     *          |       `--SEMI -> ;
854     *          |--EXPR -> EXPR
855     *          |   `--POST_INC -> ++
856     *          |       `--IDENT -> i
857     *          |--SEMI -> ;
858     *          `--RCURLY -> }
859     * }
860     *
861     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.7">Java
862     *     Language Specification, &sect;14.7</a>
863     * @see #SLIST
864     */
865    public static final int LABELED_STAT =
866        JavaLanguageLexer.LABELED_STAT;
867
868    /**
869     * A type-cast.
870     *
871     * <p>For example:</p>
872     * {@snippet :
873     * (String)it.next()
874     * }
875     *
876     * <p>parses as:</p>
877     * {@snippet :
878     * `--TYPECAST -> (
879     *     |--TYPE -> TYPE
880     *     |   `--IDENT -> String
881     *     |--RPAREN -> )
882     *     `--METHOD_CALL -> (
883     *         |--DOT -> .
884     *         |   |--IDENT -> it
885     *         |   `--IDENT -> next
886     *         |--ELIST -> ELIST
887     *         `--RPAREN -> )
888     * }
889     *
890     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.16">Java
891     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.16</a>
892     * @see #EXPR
893     * @see #TYPE
894     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENTS
895     * @see #RPAREN
896     */
897    public static final int TYPECAST = JavaLanguageLexer.TYPECAST;
898    /**
899     * The array index operator.
900     *
901     * <p>For example:</p>
902     * {@snippet :
903     * arr[0] = 10;
904     * }
905     *
906     * <p>parses as:</p>
907     * {@snippet :
908     * |--EXPR -> EXPR
909     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
910     * |       |--INDEX_OP -> [
911     * |       |   |--IDENT -> arr
912     * |       |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
913     * |       |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 0
914     * |       |   `--RBRACK -> ]
915     * |       `--NUM_INT -> 10
916     * |--SEMI -> ;
917     * }
918     *
919     * @see #EXPR
920     */
921    public static final int INDEX_OP = JavaLanguageLexer.INDEX_OP;
922    /**
923     * The {@code ++} (postfix increment) operator.
924     *
925     * <p>For example:</p>
926     * {@snippet :
927     * a++;
928     * }
929     *
930     * <p>parses as:</p>
931     * {@snippet :
932     * |--EXPR -> EXPR
933     * |   `--POST_INC -> ++
934     * |       `--IDENT -> a
935     * |--SEMI -> ;
936     * }
937     *
938     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.14.1">Java
939     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.14.1</a>
940     * @see #EXPR
941     * @see #INC
942     */
943    public static final int POST_INC = JavaLanguageLexer.POST_INC;
944    /**
945     * The {@code --} (postfix decrement) operator.
946     *
947     * <p>For example:</p>
948     * {@snippet :
949     * a--;
950     * }
951     *
952     * <p>parses as:</p>
953     * {@snippet :
954     * |--EXPR -> EXPR
955     * |   `--POST_DEC -> --
956     * |       `--IDENT -> a
957     * |--SEMI -> ;
958     * }
959     *
960     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.14.2">Java
961     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.14.2</a>
962     * @see #EXPR
963     * @see #DEC
964     */
965    public static final int POST_DEC = JavaLanguageLexer.POST_DEC;
966    /**
967     * A method call. A method call may have type arguments however these
968     * are attached to the appropriate node in the qualified method name.
969     *
970     * <p>For example:</p>
971     * {@snippet :
972     * Integer.parseInt("123");
973     * }
974     *
975     * <p>parses as:</p>
976     * {@snippet :
977     * |--EXPR -> EXPR
978     * |   `--METHOD_CALL -> (
979     * |       |--DOT -> .
980     * |       |   |--IDENT -> Integer
981     * |       |   `--IDENT -> parseInt
982     * |       |--ELIST -> ELIST
983     * |       |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
984     * |       |       `--STRING_LITERAL -> "123"
985     * |       `--RPAREN -> )
986     * |--SEMI -> ;
987     * }
988     *
989     *
990     * @see #IDENT
991     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENTS
992     * @see #DOT
993     * @see #ELIST
994     * @see #RPAREN
995     * @see FullIdent
996     */
997    public static final int METHOD_CALL = JavaLanguageLexer.METHOD_CALL;
998
999    /**
1000     * A reference to a method or constructor without arguments. Part of Java 8 syntax.
1001     * The token should be used for subscribing for double colon literal.
1002     * {@link #DOUBLE_COLON} token does not appear in the tree.
1003     *
1004     * <p>For example:</p>
1005     * {@snippet :
1006     * Comparator<String> compare = String::compareToIgnoreCase;
1007     * }
1008     *
1009     * <p>parses as:
1010     * {@snippet :
1011     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
1012     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
1013     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
1014     * |   |   |--IDENT -> Comparator
1015     * |   |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -> TYPE_ARGUMENTS
1016     * |   |       |--GENERIC_START -> <
1017     * |   |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -> TYPE_ARGUMENT
1018     * |   |       |   `--IDENT -> String
1019     * |   |       `--GENERIC_END -> >
1020     * |   |--IDENT -> compare
1021     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
1022     * |       `--EXPR -> EXPR
1023     * |           `--METHOD_REF -> ::
1024     * |               |--IDENT -> String
1025     * |               `--IDENT -> compareToIgnoreCase
1026     * |--SEMI -> ;
1027     * }
1028     *
1029     * @see #IDENT
1030     * @see #DOUBLE_COLON
1031     */
1032    public static final int METHOD_REF = JavaLanguageLexer.METHOD_REF;
1033    /**
1034     * An expression.  Operators with lower precedence appear at a
1035     * higher level in the tree than operators with higher precedence.
1036     * Parentheses are siblings to the operator they enclose.
1037     *
1038     * <p>For example:</p>
1039     * {@snippet :
1040     * int x = 4 + 2 * (5 % 3) + (1 << 3) - 4 * 5;
1041     * }
1042     *
1043     * <p>parses as:</p>
1044     * {@snippet :
1045     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
1046     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
1047     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
1048     * |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
1049     * |   |--IDENT -> x
1050     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
1051     * |       `--EXPR -> EXPR
1052     * |           `--MINUS -> -
1053     * |               |--PLUS -> +
1054     * |               |   |--PLUS -> +
1055     * |               |   |   |--NUM_INT -> 4
1056     * |               |   |   `--STAR -> *
1057     * |               |   |       |--NUM_INT -> 2
1058     * |               |   |       |--LPAREN -> (
1059     * |               |   |       |--MOD -> %
1060     * |               |   |       |   |--NUM_INT -> 5
1061     * |               |   |       |   `--NUM_INT -> 3
1062     * |               |   |       `--RPAREN -> )
1063     * |               |   |--LPAREN -> (
1064     * |               |   |--SL -> <<
1065     * |               |   |   |--NUM_INT -> 1
1066     * |               |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 3
1067     * |               |   `--RPAREN -> )
1068     * |               `--STAR -> *
1069     * |                   |--NUM_INT -> 4
1070     * |                   `--NUM_INT -> 5
1071     * |--SEMI -> ;
1072     * }
1073     *
1074     * @see #ELIST
1075     * @see #ASSIGN
1076     * @see #LPAREN
1077     * @see #RPAREN
1078     */
1079    public static final int EXPR = JavaLanguageLexer.EXPR;
1080    /**
1081     * An array initialization.  This may occur as part of an array
1082     * declaration or inline with {@code new}.
1083     *
1084     * <p>For example:</p>
1085     * {@snippet :
1086     *   int[] y =
1087     *     {
1088     *       1,
1089     *       2,
1090     *     };
1091     * }
1092     *
1093     * <p>parses as:</p>
1094     * {@snippet :
1095     * VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
1096     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
1097     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
1098     *  |   |--LITERAL_INT -> int
1099     *  |   `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -> [
1100     *  |       `--RBRACK -> ]
1101     *  |--IDENT -> y
1102     *  |--ASSIGN -> =
1103     *  |   `--ARRAY_INIT -> {
1104     *  |       |--EXPR -> EXPR
1105     *  |       |   `--NUM_INT -> 1
1106     *  |       |--COMMA -> ,
1107     *  |       |--EXPR -> EXPR
1108     *  |       |   `--NUM_INT -> 2
1109     *  |       |--COMMA -> ,
1110     *  |       `--RCURLY -> }
1111     *  `--SEMI -> ;
1112     * }
1113     *
1114     * <p>Also consider:</p>
1115     * {@snippet :
1116     *   int[] z = new int[]
1117     *     {
1118     *       1,
1119     *       2,
1120     *     };
1121     * }
1122     *
1123     * <p>which parses as:</p>
1124     * {@snippet :
1125     * VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
1126     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
1127     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE [2:4]
1128     *  |   |--LITERAL_INT -> int
1129     *  |   `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -> [
1130     *  |       `--RBRACK -> ]
1131     *  |--IDENT -> z
1132     *  |--ASSIGN -> =
1133     *  |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
1134     *  |       `--LITERAL_NEW -> new
1135     *  |           |--LITERAL_INT -> int
1136     *  |           |--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -> [
1137     *  |           |   `--RBRACK -> ]
1138     *  |           `--ARRAY_INIT -> {
1139     *  |               |--EXPR -> EXPR
1140     *  |               |   `--NUM_INT -> 1
1141     *  |               |--COMMA -> ,
1142     *  |               |--EXPR -> EXPR
1143     *  |               |   `--NUM_INT -> 2
1144     *  |               |--COMMA -> ,
1145     *  |               `--RCURLY -> }
1146     *  `--SEMI -> ;
1147     * }
1148     *
1149     * @see #ARRAY_DECLARATOR
1150     * @see #TYPE
1151     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
1152     * @see #COMMA
1153     */
1154    public static final int ARRAY_INIT = JavaLanguageLexer.ARRAY_INIT;
1155    /**
1156     * An import declaration.  Import declarations are option, but
1157     * must appear after the package declaration and before the first type declaration.
1158     *
1159     * <p>For example:</p>
1160     *
1161     * {@snippet :
1162     *   import java.io.IOException;
1163     * }
1164     *
1165     * <p>parses as:</p>
1166     *
1167     * {@snippet :
1168     * IMPORT -> import
1169     * |--DOT -> .
1170     * |   |--DOT -> .
1171     * |   |   |--IDENT -> java
1172     * |   |   `--IDENT -> io
1173     * |   `--IDENT -> IOException
1174     * `--SEMI -> ;
1175     * }
1176     *
1177     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.5">Java
1178     *     Language Specification &sect;7.5</a>
1179     * @see #DOT
1180     * @see #IDENT
1181     * @see #STAR
1182     * @see #SEMI
1183     * @see FullIdent
1184     */
1185    public static final int IMPORT = JavaLanguageLexer.IMPORT;
1186    /**
1187     * The {@code -} (unary minus) operator.
1188     *
1189     * <p>For example:</p>
1190     * {@snippet :
1191     * a = -b;
1192     * }
1193     *
1194     * <p>parses as:</p>
1195     * {@snippet :
1196     * |--EXPR -> EXPR
1197     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
1198     * |       |--IDENT -> a
1199     * |       `--UNARY_MINUS -> -
1200     * |           `--IDENT -> b
1201     * |--SEMI -> ;
1202     * }
1203     *
1204     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.15.4">Java
1205     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.15.4</a>
1206     * @see #EXPR
1207     */
1208    public static final int UNARY_MINUS = JavaLanguageLexer.UNARY_MINUS;
1209    /**
1210     * The {@code +} (unary plus) operator.
1211     *
1212     * <p>For example:</p>
1213     * {@snippet :
1214     * a = + b;
1215     * }
1216     *
1217     * <p>parses as:</p>
1218     * {@snippet :
1219     * |--EXPR -> EXPR
1220     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
1221     * |       |--IDENT -> a
1222     * |       `--UNARY_PLUS -> +
1223     * |           `--IDENT -> b
1224     * |--SEMI -> ;
1225     * }
1226     *
1227     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.15.3">Java
1228     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.15.3</a>
1229     * @see #EXPR
1230     */
1231    public static final int UNARY_PLUS = JavaLanguageLexer.UNARY_PLUS;
1232    /**
1233     * A group of case clauses.  Case clauses with no associated
1234     * statements are grouped together into a case group.  The last
1235     * child is a statement list containing the statements to execute upon a match.
1236     *
1237     * <p>For example:</p>
1238     * {@snippet :
1239     * case 0:
1240     * case 1:
1241     * case 2:
1242     *   x = 3;
1243     *   break;
1244     * }
1245     *
1246     * <p>parses as:</p>
1247     * {@snippet :
1248     * CASE_GROUP -> CASE_GROUP
1249     *  |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
1250     *  |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
1251     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 0
1252     *  |   `--COLON -> :
1253     *  |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
1254     *  |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
1255     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 1
1256     *  |   `--COLON -> :
1257     *  |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
1258     *  |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
1259     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 2
1260     *  |   `--COLON -> :
1261     *  `--SLIST -> SLIST
1262     *      |--EXPR -> EXPR
1263     *      |   `--ASSIGN -> =
1264     *      |       |--IDENT -> x
1265     *      |       `--NUM_INT -> 3
1266     *      |--SEMI -> ;
1267     *      `--LITERAL_BREAK -> break
1268     *          `--SEMI -> ;
1269     * }
1270     *
1271     * @see #LITERAL_CASE
1272     * @see #LITERAL_DEFAULT
1273     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
1274     * @see #LITERAL_YIELD
1275     */
1276    public static final int CASE_GROUP = JavaLanguageLexer.CASE_GROUP;
1277    /**
1278     * An expression list.  The children are a comma separated list of expressions.
1279     *
1280     * <p>For example:</p>
1281     * {@snippet :
1282     * new ArrayList(50);
1283     * }
1284     *
1285     * <p>parses as:</p>
1286     * {@snippet :
1287     * |--EXPR -> EXPR
1288     * |   `--LITERAL_NEW -> new
1289     * |       |--IDENT -> ArrayList
1290     * |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -> TYPE_ARGUMENTS

2624     *  |   |       `--STRING_LITERAL -> "half full"

4399     *  |   `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -> [
4400     *  |       `--RBRACK -> ]
4401     *  |--IDENT -> strings
4402     *  |--ASSIGN -> =
4403     *  |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
4404     *  |       `--LITERAL_NEW -> new
4405     *  |           |--IDENT -> String

4407     *  |               |--EXPR -> EXPR

4424     * {@snippet :

4448     *  |               |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
4449     *  |               |   |   |--ANNOTATION -> ANNOTATION
4450     *  |               |   |   |   |--AT -> @
4451     *  |               |   |   |   `--IDENT -> Override
4452     *  |               |   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public

4455     *  |               |   |--IDENT -> get
4456     *  |               |   |--LPAREN -> (
4457     *  |               |   |--PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
4458     *  |               |   |--RPAREN -> )
4459     *  |               |   `--SLIST -> {
4460     *  |               |       |--LITERAL_RETURN -> return
4461     *  |               |       |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
4462     *  |               |       |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 42
4463     *  |               |       |   `--SEMI -> ;
4464     *  |               |       `--RCURLY -> }
4465     *  |               `--RCURLY -> }
4466     *  `--SEMI -> ;
4467     * }
4468     *
4469     * @see #IDENT
4470     * @see #DOT
4471     * @see #LPAREN
4472     * @see #ELIST
4473     * @see #RPAREN
4474     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4475     * @see #ARRAY_INIT
4476     * @see FullIdent

4679    /**
4680     * An enum declaration. Its notable children are enum constant declarations followed by
4681     * any construct that may be expected in a class body.
4682     *
4683     * <p>For example:</p>
4684     * {@snippet :
4685     * public enum MyEnum
4686     *   implements Serializable
4687     * {
4688     *     FIRST_CONSTANT,
4689     *     SECOND_CONSTANT;
4690     *
4691     *     public void someMethod()
4692     *     {
4693     *     }
4694     * }
4695     * }
4696     *
4697     * <p>parses as:</p>
4698     * {@snippet :
4699     * ENUM_DEF -> ENUM_DEF
4700     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
4701     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
4702     *  |--ENUM -> enum
4703     *  |--IDENT -> MyEnum
4704     *  |--IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE -> implements
4705     *  |   `--IDENT -> Serializable
4706     *  `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
4707     *      |--LCURLY -> {
4708     *      |--ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF -> ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
4709     *      |   |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
4710     *      |   `--IDENT -> FIRST_CONSTANT
4711     *      |--COMMA -> ,
4712     *      |--ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF -> ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
4713     *      |   |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
4714     *      |   `--IDENT -> SECOND_CONSTANT
4715     *      |--SEMI -> ;
4716     *      |--METHOD_DEF -> METHOD_DEF
4717     *      |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
4718     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
4719     *      |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
4720     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_VOID -> void
4721     *      |   |--IDENT -> someMethod
4722     *      |   |--LPAREN -> (
4723     *      |   |--PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
4724     *      |   |--RPAREN -> )
4725     *      |   `--SLIST -> {
4726     *      |       `--RCURLY -> }
4727     *      `--RCURLY -> }
4728     * }
4729     *
4730     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201"> JSR201</a>
4731     * @see #MODIFIERS
4732     * @see #ENUM
4733     * @see #IDENT
4734     * @see #EXTENDS_CLAUSE
4735     * @see #IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE
4736     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4737     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
4738     * @see #ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
4739     */

4741        JavaLanguageLexer.ENUM_DEF;

4743    /**
4744     * The {@code enum} keyword.  This element appears as part of an enum declaration.
4745     *

4747     * {@snippet :
4748     * public enum Count {}
4749     * }

4751     * <p>parses as:</p>
4752     * {@snippet :
4753     * ENUM_DEF -> ENUM_DEF
4754     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS

4756     *  |--ENUM -> enum
4757     *  |--IDENT -> Count
4758     *  `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
4759     *      |--LCURLY -> {
4760     *      `--RCURLY -> }
4761     * }
4762     *
4763     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">JSR201</a>
4764     * @see #MODIFIERS
4765     * @see #ENUM_DEF
4766     * @see #IDENT
4767     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4768     */
4769    public static final int ENUM =
4770        JavaLanguageLexer.ENUM;

4772    /**
4773     * An enum constant declaration. Its notable children are annotations,

4776     * <p>For example:</p>
4777     * {@snippet :
4778     * SOME_CONSTANT(1)

4782     *     }
4783     * }
4784     * }

4787     * {@snippet :

4791     *   |   |--LPAREN -> (
4792     *   |   |--ELIST -> ELIST
4793     *   |   |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
4794     *   |   |       `--NUM_INT -> 1
4795     *   |   |--RPAREN -> )
4796     *   |   `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
4797     *   |       |--LCURLY -> {
4798     *   |       |--METHOD_DEF -> METHOD_DEF
4799     *   |       |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
4800     *   |       |   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
4801     *   |       |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
4802     *   |       |   |   `--LITERAL_VOID -> void
4803     *   |       |   |--IDENT -> someMethodOverriddenFromMainBody
4804     *   |       |   |--LPAREN -> (
4805     *   |       |   |--PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
4806     *   |       |   |--RPAREN -> )
4807     *   |       |   `--SLIST -> {
4808     *   |       |       `--RCURLY -> }
4809     *   |       `--RCURLY -> }
4810     * }
4811     *
4812     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201"> JSR201</a>
4813     * @see #ANNOTATIONS
4814     * @see #MODIFIERS
4815     * @see #IDENT
4816     * @see #ELIST
4817     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4818     */

4820        JavaLanguageLexer.ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF;

4822    /**
4823     * A for-each clause.  This is a child of

4825     * a parameter definition, the colon literal and an expression.

4828     * {@snippet :
4829     * for (int value : values) {
4830     *     doSomething();
4831     * }
4832     * }

4835     * {@snippet :
4836     * LITERAL_FOR -> for

4838     *  |--FOR_EACH_CLAUSE -> FOR_EACH_CLAUSE
4839     *  |   |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
4840     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
4841     *  |   |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
4842     *  |   |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
4843     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> value
4844     *  |   |--COLON -> :
4845     *  |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
4846     *  |       `--IDENT -> values
4847     *  |--RPAREN -> )
4848     *  `--SLIST -> {
4849     *      |--EXPR -> EXPR
4850     *      |   `--METHOD_CALL -> (
4851     *      |       |--IDENT -> doSomething
4852     *      |       |--ELIST -> ELIST
4853     *      |       `--RPAREN -> )
4854     *      |--SEMI -> ;
4855     *      `--RCURLY -> }
4856     * }

4858     * @see #VARIABLE_DEF
4859     * @see #ELIST
4860     * @see #LITERAL_FOR
4861     */

4863        JavaLanguageLexer.FOR_EACH_CLAUSE;

4865    /**
4866     * An annotation declaration. The notable children are the name of the

4871     * public @interface MyAnnotation

4879     * ANNOTATION_DEF -> ANNOTATION_DEF

4882     *  |--AT -> @
4883     *  |--LITERAL_INTERFACE -> interface
4884     *  |--IDENT -> MyAnnotation
4885     *  `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK

4887     *      |--ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF -> ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF
4888     *      |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
4889     *      |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
4890     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
4891     *      |   |--IDENT -> someValue

4893     *      |   |--RPAREN -> )

4901     * @see #IDENT
4902     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4903     * @see #ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF
4904     */

4906        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATION_DEF;

4908    /**
4909     * An annotation field declaration.  The notable children are modifiers,
4910     * field type, field name and an optional default value (a conditional
4911     * compile-time constant expression). Default values may also be annotations.
4912     *

4914     *
4915     * {@snippet :
4916     *     String someField() default "Hello world";
4917     * }

4921     * {@snippet :
4922     * ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF -> ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF

4924     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
4925     *  |   `--IDENT -> String
4926     *  |--IDENT -> someField
4927     *  |--LPAREN -> (
4928     *  |--RPAREN -> )
4929     *  |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -> default
4930     *  |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
4931     *  |       `--STRING_LITERAL -> "Hello world"

4933     * }

4943    /**
4944     * A collection of annotations on a package or enum constant.
4945     * A collections of annotations will only occur on these nodes

4947     * be qualified with any other modifier and hence these annotations
4948     * would be contained in a {@link #MODIFIERS} node.
4949     *

4951     *
4952     * {@snippet :
4953     *     @MyAnnotation package blah;
4954     * }

4956     * <p>parses as:</p>
4957     *
4958     * {@snippet :
4959     * PACKAGE_DEF -> package
4960     *  |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
4961     *  |   `--ANNOTATION -> ANNOTATION
4962     *  |       |--AT -> @
4963     *  |       `--IDENT -> MyAnnotation
4964     *  |--IDENT -> blah
4965     *  `--SEMI -> ;
4966     * }
4967     *
4968     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201"> JSR201</a>
4969     * @see #ANNOTATION
4970     * @see #AT
4971     * @see #IDENT
4972     */
4973    public static final int ANNOTATIONS =
4974        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATIONS;

4976    /**
4977     * An annotation of a package, type, field, parameter or variable.
4978     * An annotation may occur anywhere modifiers occur (it is a
4979     * type of modifier) and may also occur prior to a package definition.
4980     * The notable children are: The annotation name and either a single
4981     * default annotation value or a sequence of name value pairs.
4982     * Annotation values may also be annotations themselves.
4983     *
4984     * <p>For example:</p>
4985     * {@snippet :
4986     *     @MyAnnotation(someField1 = "Hello",
4987     *                    someField2 = @SomeOtherAnnotation)
4988     * }

4990     * <p>parses as:</p>
4991     * {@snippet :
4992     * ANNOTATION -> ANNOTATION
4993     *  |--AT -> @
4994     *  |--IDENT -> MyAnnotation
4995     *  |--LPAREN -> (
4996     *  |--ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR -> ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
4997     *  |   |--IDENT -> someField1
4998     *  |   |--ASSIGN -> =
4999     *  |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
5000     *  |       `--STRING_LITERAL -> "Hello"
5001     *  |--COMMA -> ,
5002     *  |--ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR -> ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
5003     *  |   |--IDENT -> someField2
5004     *  |   |--ASSIGN -> =
5005     *  |   `--ANNOTATION -> ANNOTATION
5006     *  |       |--AT -> @
5007     *  |       `--IDENT -> SomeOtherAnnotation
5008     *  `--RPAREN -> )
5009     * }
5010     *
5011     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201"> JSR201</a>
5012     * @see #MODIFIERS
5013     * @see #IDENT
5014     * @see #ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
5015     */
5016    public static final int ANNOTATION =
5017        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATION;
5018
5019    /**
5020     * An initialization of an annotation member with a value.
5021     * Its children are the name of the member, the assignment literal
5022     * and the (compile-time constant conditional expression) value.
5023     *
5024     * <p>For example:</p>
5025     * {@snippet :
5026     * @Annotation(
5027     *     value="123"
5028     * )
5029     * }

5031     * <p>parses as:</p>
5032     * {@snippet :
5033     * ANNOTATION -> ANNOTATION
5034     *  |--AT -> @
5035     *  |--IDENT -> Annotation
5036     *  |--LPAREN -> (
5037     *  |--ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR -> ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
5038     *  |   |--IDENT -> value
5039     *  |   |--ASSIGN -> =
5040     *  |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
5041     *  |       `--STRING_LITERAL -> "123"
5042     *  `--RPAREN -> )
5043     * }
5044     *

5052    /**
5053     * An annotation array member initialization.
5054     * Initializers can not be nested.
5055     * An initializer may be present as a default to an annotation
5056     * member, as the single default value to an annotation

5060     * {@snippet :
5061     * @Annotation({1, 2})

5065     * {@snippet :
5066     * ANNOTATION -> ANNOTATION
5067     *  |--AT -> @
5068     *  |--IDENT -> Annotation
5069     *  |--LPAREN -> (
5070     *  |--ANNOTATION_ARRAY_INIT -> {
5071     *  |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
5072     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 1
5073     *  |   |--COMMA -> ,
5074     *  |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
5075     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 2
5076     *  |   `--RCURLY -> }
5077     *  `--RPAREN -> )
5078     * }
5079     *
5080     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201"> JSR201</a>

5084     */
5085    public static final int ANNOTATION_ARRAY_INIT =
5086        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATION_ARRAY_INIT;

5088    /**
5089     * A list of type parameters to a class, interface or
5090     * method definition. Children are LT, at least one
5091     * TYPE_PARAMETER, zero or more of: a COMMAs followed by a single TYPE_PARAMETER and a final GT.
5092     *
5093     * <p>For example:</p>
5094     *
5095     * {@snippet :
5096     * public class MyClass<A, B> {

5098     * }

5103     * {@snippet :
5104     * CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF

5106     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
5107     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
5108     * |--IDENT -> MyClass
5109     * |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -> TYPE_PARAMETERS
5110     * |   |--GENERIC_START -> <
5111     * |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -> TYPE_PARAMETER
5112     * |   |   `--IDENT -> A
5113     * |   |--COMMA -> ,
5114     * |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -> TYPE_PARAMETER
5115     * |   |   `--IDENT -> B
5116     * |   `--GENERIC_END -> >
5117     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
5118     *     |--LCURLY -> {
5119     *     `--RCURLY -> }
5120     * }

5123     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>

5125     * @see #GENERIC_END
5126     * @see #TYPE_PARAMETER
5127     * @see #COMMA
5128     */
5129    public static final int TYPE_PARAMETERS =
5130        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_PARAMETERS;

5132    /**
5133     * A type parameter to a class, interface or method definition.
5134     * Children are the type name and an optional TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS.
5135     *
5136     * <p>For example:</p>
5137     *
5138     * {@snippet :
5139     * public class MyClass <A extends Collection> {
5140     *
5141     * }
5142     * }
5143     *
5144     * <p>parses as:</p>
5145     *
5146     * {@snippet :
5147     * CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF
5148     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5149     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
5150     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
5151     * |--IDENT -> MyClass
5152     * |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -> TYPE_PARAMETERS
5153     * |   |--GENERIC_START -> <
5154     * |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -> TYPE_PARAMETER
5155     * |   |   |--IDENT -> A
5156     * |   |   `--TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS -> extends
5157     * |   |       `--IDENT -> Collection
5158     * |   `--GENERIC_END -> >
5159     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
5160     *     |--LCURLY -> {
5161     *     `--RCURLY -> }
5162     * }

5164     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5165     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>

5167     * @see #WILDCARD_TYPE
5168     * @see #TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS
5169     */
5170    public static final int TYPE_PARAMETER =
5171        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_PARAMETER;

5173    /**
5174     * A list of type arguments to a type reference or
5175     * a method/ctor invocation. Children are GENERIC_START, at least one
5176     * TYPE_ARGUMENT, zero or more of a COMMAs followed by a single
5177     * TYPE_ARGUMENT, and a final GENERIC_END.
5178     *
5179     * <p>For example:</p>
5180     *
5181     * {@snippet :
5182     *     public Collection<?> a;
5183     * }
5184     *

5186     *
5187     * {@snippet :
5188     * VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5189     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5190     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
5191     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
5192     *  |   |--IDENT -> Collection
5193     *  |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -> TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5194     *  |       |--GENERIC_START -> <
5195     *  |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -> TYPE_ARGUMENT
5196     *  |       |   `--WILDCARD_TYPE -> ?
5197     *  |       `--GENERIC_END -> >
5198     *  |--IDENT -> a
5199     *  `--SEMI -> ;
5200     * }
5201     *
5202     * @see #GENERIC_START
5203     * @see #GENERIC_END
5204     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENT
5205     * @see #COMMA
5206     */

5208        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_ARGUMENTS;
5209
5210    /**
5211     * A type arguments to a type reference or a method/ctor invocation.
5212     * Children are either: type name or wildcard type with possible type upper or lower bounds.
5213     *
5214     * <p>For example: {@code List< ? super List> list }</p>
5215     *
5216     * <p>parses as:</p>
5217     * {@snippet :
5218     * VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5219     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5220     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
5221     *  |   |--IDENT -> List
5222     *  |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -> TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5223     *  |       |--GENERIC_START -> <
5224     *  |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -> TYPE_ARGUMENT
5225     *  |       |   |--WILDCARD_TYPE -> ?
5226     *  |       |   `--TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS -> super
5227     *  |       |       `--IDENT -> List
5228     *  |       `--GENERIC_END -> >
5229     *  |--IDENT -> list
5230     *  `--SEMI -> ;
5231     * }
5232     *
5233     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5234     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>

5237     * @see #TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS
5238     */

5240        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_ARGUMENT;

5242    /**
5243     * The type that refers to all types. This node has no children.
5244     *
5245     * <p>For example: </p>
5246     * {@snippet :
5247     *
5248     * List<?> list;
5249     * }
5250     *
5251     * <p>parses as:</p>
5252     * {@snippet :
5253     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5254     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5255     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
5256     * |   |   |--IDENT -> List
5257     * |   |   |`--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -> TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5258     * |   |        |--GENERIC_START -> <
5259     * |   |        |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -> TYPE_ARGUMENT
5260     * |   |        |  `--WILDCARD_TYPE -> ?
5261     * |   |        `--GENERIC_END -> >
5262     * |   `--IDENT -> list
5263     * |--SEMI -> ;
5264     * }
5265     *
5266     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5267     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>

5269     * @see #TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS
5270     * @see #TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS
5271     */

5273        JavaLanguageLexer.WILDCARD_TYPE;
5274
5275    /**
5276     * An upper bounds on a wildcard type argument or type parameter.
5277     * This node has one child - the type that is being used for the bounding.
5278     *
5279     * <p>For example: {@code List< ? extends Number> list;}</p>
5280     *
5281     * <p>parses as:</p>
5282     * {@snippet :
5283     * --VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5284     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5285     *  |--TYPE -> TYPE
5286     *  |   |--IDENT -> List
5287     *  |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -> TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5288     *  |       |--GENERIC_START -> <
5289     *  |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -> TYPE_ARGUMENT
5290     *  |       |   |--WILDCARD_TYPE -> ?
5291     *  |       |   `--TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS -> extends
5292     *  |       |       `--IDENT -> Number
5293     *  |       `--GENERIC_END -> >
5294     *  |--IDENT -> list
5295     *  `--SEMI -> ;
5296     * }
5297     *
5298     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5299     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>
5300     * @see #TYPE_PARAMETER
5301     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENT
5302     * @see #WILDCARD_TYPE
5303     */
5304    public static final int TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS =
5305        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS;
5306
5307    /**
5308     * A lower bounds on a wildcard type argument. This node has one child
5309     *  - the type that is being used for the bounding.
5310     *
5311     *  <p>For example: {@code List< ? super Integer> list;}</p>
5312     *
5313     *  <p>parses as:</p>
5314     *  {@snippet :
5315     *  --VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5316     *     |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5317     *     |--TYPE -> TYPE
5318     *     |   |--IDENT -> List
5319     *     |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -> TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5320     *     |       |--GENERIC_START -> <
5321     *     |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -> TYPE_ARGUMENT
5322     *     |       |   |--WILDCARD_TYPE -> ?
5323     *     |       |   `--TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS -> super
5324     *     |       |       `--IDENT -> Integer
5325     *     |       `--GENERIC_END -> >
5326     *     |--IDENT -> list
5327     *     `--SEMI -> ;
5328     *  }
5329     *
5330     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5331     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>
5332     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENT
5333     * @see #WILDCARD_TYPE
5334     */

5336        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS;

5338    /**
5339     * An {@code @} symbol - signifying an annotation instance or the prefix
5340     * to the interface literal signifying the definition of an annotation declaration.
5341     *
5342     * <p>For example:</p>

5344     * @Deprecated
5345     * private int value;

5349     * {@snippet :
5350     * VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5351     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5352     * |  |--ANNOTATION -> ANNOTATION
5353     * |  |  |--AT -> @

5355     * |  `--LITERAL_PRIVATE -> private
5356     * |--TYPE -> TYPE
5357     * |  `--LITERAL_INT -> int

5366    /**
5367     * A triple dot for variable-length parameters. This token only ever occurs
5368     * in a parameter declaration immediately after the type of the parameter.
5369     *
5370     * <p>For example:</p>

5372     *  public void myShape(int... dimension) {
5373     *
5374     *  }

5378     * {@snippet :
5379     * METHOD_DEF -> METHOD_DEF

5381     *   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
5382     *   |--TYPE -> TYPE
5383     *   |   `--LITERAL_VOID -> void
5384     *   |--IDENT -> myShape
5385     *   |--LPAREN -> (
5386     *   |--PARAMETERS -> PARAMETERS
5387     *   |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -> PARAMETER_DEF
5388     *   |       |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5389     *   |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
5390     *   |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
5391     *   |       |--ELLIPSIS -> ...
5392     *   |       `--IDENT -> dimension
5393     *   |--RPAREN -> )
5394     *   `--SLIST -> {
5395     *       `--RCURLY -> }
5396     * }
5397     *

5399     */

5402    /**
5403     * The {@code &} symbol when used to extend a generic upper or lower bounds constrain
5404     * or a type cast expression with an additional interface.
5405     *
5406     * <p>Generic type bounds extension:
5407     * {@code class Comparable<T extends Serializable & CharSequence>}</p>
5408     * {@snippet :
5409     * CLASS_DEF -> CLASS_DEF
5410     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5411     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -> class
5412     * |--IDENT -> Comparable
5413     * |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -> TYPE_PARAMETERS
5414     *     |--GENERIC_START -> <
5415     *     |--TYPE_PARAMETER -> TYPE_PARAMETER
5416     *     |   |--IDENT -> T
5417     *     |   `--TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS -> extends
5418     *     |       |--IDENT -> Serializable
5419     *     |       |--TYPE_EXTENSION_AND -> &
5420     *     |       `--IDENT -> CharSequence
5421     *     `--GENERIC_END -> >
5422     * }
5423     *
5424     * <p>Type cast extension:
5425     * {@code return (Serializable & CharSequence) null;}</p>

5427     * --LITERAL_RETURN -> return
5428     *    |--EXPR -> EXPR
5429     *    |   `--TYPECAST -> (
5430     *    |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
5431     *    |       |   `--IDENT -> Serializable
5432     *    |       |--TYPE_EXTENSION_AND -> &
5433     *    |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
5434     *    |       |   `--IDENT -> CharSequence
5435     *    |       |--RPAREN -> )
5436     *    |       `--LITERAL_NULL -> null
5437     *    `--SEMI -> ;
5438     * }
5439     *
5440     * @see #EXTENDS_CLAUSE
5441     * @see #TYPECAST
5442     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-4.html#jls-4.4">
5443     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;4.4</a>
5444     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.16">
5445     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;15.16</a>
5446     */

5448        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_EXTENSION_AND;

5450    /**
5451     * A {@code <} symbol signifying the start of type arguments or type parameters.

5467     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> T

5470     *      |--LCURLY -> {
5471     *      `--RCURLY -> }

5483    /**

5496     *  |--IDENT -> Test
5497     *  |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -> TYPE_PARAMETERS
5498     *  |   |--GENERIC_START -> <
5499     *  |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -> TYPE_PARAMETER
5500     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> T
5501     *  |   `--GENERIC_END -> >
5502     *  `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
5503     *      |--LCURLY -> {

5515    /**
5516     * Special lambda symbol {@code ->}.

5530     *  |   `--LAMBDA -> ->

5534     *  |       |       |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5535     *  |       |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
5536     *  |       |       `--IDENT -> n
5537     *  |       |--RPAREN -> )
5538     *  |       `--EXPR -> EXPR
5539     *  |           `--METHOD_CALL -> (
5540     *  |               |--DOT -> .
5541     *  |               |   |--DOT -> .
5542     *  |               |   |   |--IDENT -> System
5543     *  |               |   |   `--IDENT -> out
5544     *  |               |   `--IDENT -> println
5545     *  |               |--ELIST -> ELIST
5546     *  |               |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
5547     *  |               |       `--IDENT -> n
5548     *  |               `--RPAREN -> )
5549     *  `--RPAREN -> )
5550     * }

5556     * Beginning of single-line comment: '//'.

5560     *  `--COMMENT_CONTENT -> \r\n
5561     * }

5564     * {@snippet :
5565     * // Comment content
5566     * }

5577    /**

5582     * /* Comment content

5584     * }</pre>

5587     * {@snippet :
5588     * --BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN -> /*
5589     *    |--COMMENT_CONTENT ->  Comment content\r\n

5591     * }

5594            JavaLanguageLexer.BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN;

5596    /**
5597     * End of block comment: '* /'.

5600     * {@snippet :
5601     * /*comment* /
5602     * }
5603     *
5604     * <p>parses as:</p>
5605     * {@snippet :
5606     * BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN -> /*
5607     *  |--COMMENT_CONTENT -> comment

5609     * }
5610     *

5613            JavaLanguageLexer.BLOCK_COMMENT_END;

5615    /**
5616     * Text of single-line or block comment.
5617     *
5618     * <p>For example:</p>
5619     * <pre>{@code
5620     * //this is single-line comment
5621     *
5622     * /*
5623     * this is multiline comment
5624     *  * /
5625     * }</pre>
5626     *
5627     * <p>parses as:</p>
5628     * {@snippet :
5629     * |--SINGLE_LINE_COMMENT -> //
5630     * |   `--COMMENT_CONTENT -> this is single-line comment\n
5631     * |--BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN -> /*
5632     * |   |--COMMENT_CONTENT -> \n\t\t\tthis is multiline comment\n\t\t
5633     * |   `--BLOCK_COMMENT_END -> * /
5634     * }
5635     *
5636     */
5637    public static final int COMMENT_CONTENT =

5671    /**
5672     * The {@code record} keyword.  This element appears as part of a record declaration.

5677     *
5678     * }
5679     * }
5680     *

5682     * {@snippet :
5683     * RECORD_DEF -> RECORD_DEF

5686     * |--LITERAL_RECORD -> record
5687     * |--IDENT -> MyRecord
5688     * |--LPAREN -> (
5689     * |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -> RECORD_COMPONENTS
5690     * |--RPAREN -> )

5701    /**
5702     * A declaration of a record specifies a name, a header, and a body.
5703     * The header lists the components of the record, which are the variables
5704     * that make up its state.
5705     *
5706     * <p>For example:</p>
5707     * {@snippet :
5708     * public record MyRecord () {
5709     *
5710     * }
5711     * }
5712     *
5713     * <p>parses as:</p>
5714     * {@snippet :
5715     * RECORD_DEF -> RECORD_DEF
5716     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5717     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
5718     * |--LITERAL_RECORD -> record
5719     * |--IDENT -> MyRecord
5720     * |--LPAREN -> (
5721     * |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -> RECORD_COMPONENTS
5722     * |--RPAREN -> )
5723     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
5724     *     |--LCURLY -> {
5725     *     `--RCURLY -> }
5726     * }
5727     *
5728     * @since 8.35
5729     */
5730    public static final int RECORD_DEF =
5731            JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_DEF;
5732
5733    /**
5734     * Record components are a (possibly empty) list containing the components of a record, which
5735     * are the variables that make up its state.
5736     *
5737     * <p>For example:</p>
5738     * {@snippet :
5739     * public record myRecord (Comp x, Comp y) { }
5740     * }
5741     *
5742     * <p>parses as:</p>
5743     * {@snippet :
5744     * RECORD_DEF -> RECORD_DEF
5745     *  |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5746     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
5747     *  |--LITERAL_RECORD -> record
5748     *  |--IDENT -> myRecord
5749     *  |--LPAREN -> (
5750     *  |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -> RECORD_COMPONENTS
5751     *  |   |--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -> RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
5752     *  |   |   |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
5753     *  |   |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
5754     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -> Comp
5755     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> x
5756     *  |   |--COMMA -> ,
5757     *  |   `--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -> RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
5758     *  |       |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
5759     *  |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
5760     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> Comp
5761     *  |       `--IDENT -> y
5762     *  |--RPAREN -> )
5763     *  `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
5764     *      |--LCURLY -> {
5765     *      `--RCURLY -> }
5766     * }
5767     *
5768     * @since 8.36
5769     */
5770    public static final int RECORD_COMPONENTS =
5771            JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_COMPONENTS;
5772
5773    /**
5774     * A record component is a variable that comprises the state of a record.  Record components
5775     * have annotations (possibly), a type definition, and an identifier.  They can also be of
5776     * variable arity ('...').
5777     *
5778     * <p>For example:</p>
5779     * {@snippet :
5780     * public record MyRecord(Comp x, Comp... comps) {
5781     *
5782     * }
5783     * }
5784     *
5785     * <p>parses as:</p>
5786     * {@snippet :
5787     * RECORD_DEF -> RECORD_DEF
5788     * |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5789     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -> public
5790     * |--LITERAL_RECORD -> record
5791     * |--IDENT -> MyRecord
5792     * |--LPAREN -> (
5793     * |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -> RECORD_COMPONENTS
5794     * |   |--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -> RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
5795     * |   |   |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
5796     * |   |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
5797     * |   |   |   `--IDENT -> Comp
5798     * |   |   `--IDENT -> x
5799     * |   |--COMMA -> ,
5800     * |   `--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -> RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
5801     * |       |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
5802     * |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
5803     * |       |   `--IDENT -> Comp
5804     * |       |--ELLIPSIS -> ...
5805     * |       `--IDENT -> comps
5806     * |--RPAREN -> )
5807     * `--OBJBLOCK -> OBJBLOCK
5808     *     |--LCURLY -> {
5809     *     `--RCURLY -> }
5810     * }
5811     *
5812     * @since 8.36
5813     */
5814    public static final int RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF =
5815            JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF;

5817    /**
5818     * A compact canonical constructor eliminates the list of formal parameters; they are
5819     * declared implicitly.
5820     *
5821     * <p>For example:</p>
5822     * {@snippet :
5823     * public record myRecord () {
5824     *     public myRecord{}
5825     * }
5826     * }
5827     *
5828     * <p>parses as:</p>
5829     * {@snippet :
5830     * RECORD_DEF
5831     * |--MODIFIERS
5832     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC (public)
5833     * |--LITERAL_RECORD (record)
5834     * |--IDENT (myRecord)
5835     * |--LPAREN (()
5836     * |--RECORD_COMPONENTS
5837     * |--RPAREN ())
5838     * `--OBJBLOCK
5839     *     |--LCURLY ({)
5840     *     |--COMPACT_CTOR_DEF
5841     *     |   |--MODIFIERS
5842     *     |   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC (public)
5843     *     |   |--IDENT (myRecord)
5844     *     |   `--SLIST ({)
5845     *     |       `--RCURLY (})
5846     *     `--RCURLY (})
5847     * }
5848     *
5849     * @since 8.36
5850     */
5851    public static final int COMPACT_CTOR_DEF =
5852            JavaLanguageLexer.COMPACT_CTOR_DEF;

5854    /**
5855     * Text blocks are a new feature added to to Java SE 15 and later
5856     * that will make writing multi-line strings much easier and cleaner.
5857     * Beginning of a Java 15 Text Block literal,
5858     * delimited by three double quotes.
5859     *
5860     * <p>For example:</p>
5861     * {@snippet :
5862     *         String hello = """
5863     *                 Hello, world!
5864     *                 """;
5865     * }
5866     *
5867     * <p>parses as:</p>
5868     * {@snippet :
5869     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5870     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5871     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
5872     * |   |   `--IDENT -> String
5873     * |   |--IDENT -> hello
5874     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
5875     * |       `--EXPR -> EXPR
5876     * |           `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN -> """
5877     * |               |--TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT -> \n                Hello, world!\n
5878     * |               `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END -> """
5879     * `--SEMI -> ;
5880     * }
5881     *
5882     * @since 8.36
5883     */
5884    public static final int TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN =
5885            JavaLanguageLexer.TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN;
5886
5887    /**
5888     * Content of a Java 15 text block. This is a
5889     * sequence of characters, possibly escaped with '\'. Actual line terminators
5890     * are represented by '\n'.
5891     *
5892     * <p>For example:</p>
5893     * {@snippet :
5894     *         String hello = """
5895     *                 Hello, world!
5896     *                 """;
5897     * }
5898     *
5899     * <p>parses as:</p>
5900     * {@snippet :
5901     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5902     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5903     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
5904     * |   |   `--IDENT -> String
5905     * |   |--IDENT -> hello
5906     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
5907     * |       `--EXPR -> EXPR
5908     * |           `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN -> """
5909     * |               |--TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT -> \n                Hello, world!\n
5910     * |               `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END -> """
5911     * `--SEMI -> ;
5912     * }
5913     *
5914     * @since 8.36
5915     */
5916    public static final int TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT =
5917            JavaLanguageLexer.TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT;
5918
5919    /**
5920     * End of a Java 15 text block literal, delimited by three double quotes.
5921     *
5922     * <p>For example:</p>
5923     * {@snippet :
5924     *         String hello = """
5925     *                 Hello, world!
5926     *                 """;
5927     * }
5928     *
5929     * <p>parses as:</p>
5930     * {@snippet :
5931     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5932     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5933     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
5934     * |   |   `--IDENT -> String
5935     * |   |--IDENT -> hello
5936     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
5937     * |       `--EXPR -> EXPR
5938     * |           `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN -> """
5939     * |               |--TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT -> \n                Hello, world!\n
5940     * |               `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END -> """
5941     * `--SEMI -> ;
5942     * }
5943     *
5944     * @since 8.36
5945     */
5946    public static final int TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END =
5947            JavaLanguageLexer.TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END;
