5949    /**
5950     * The {@code yield} keyword.  This element appears as part of a yield statement.
5951     *
5952     * <p>For example:</p>
5953     * {@snippet :
5954     * int yield = 0; // not a keyword here
5955     * return switch (mode) {
5956     *    case "a", "b":
5957     *        yield 1;
5958     *    default:
5959     *        yield - 1;
5960     * };
5961     * }
5962     *
5963     * <p>parses as:</p>
5964     * {@snippet :
5965     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -> VARIABLE_DEF
5966     * |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
5967     * |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
5968     * |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -> int
5969     * |   |--IDENT -> yield
5970     * |   `--ASSIGN -> =
5971     * |       `--EXPR -> EXPR
5972     * |           `--NUM_INT -> 0
5973     * |--SEMI -> ;
5974     * |--LITERAL_RETURN -> return
5975     * |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
5976     * |   |   `--LITERAL_SWITCH -> switch
5977     * |   |       |--LPAREN -> (
5978     * |   |       |--EXPR -> EXPR
5979     * |   |       |   `--IDENT -> mode
5980     * |   |       |--RPAREN -> )
5981     * |   |       |--LCURLY -> {
5982     * |   |       |--CASE_GROUP -> CASE_GROUP
5983     * |   |       |   |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
5984     * |   |       |   |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
5985     * |   |       |   |   |   `--STRING_LITERAL -> "a"
5986     * |   |       |   |   |--COMMA -> ,
5987     * |   |       |   |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
5988     * |   |       |   |   |   `--STRING_LITERAL -> "b"
5989     * |   |       |   |   `--COLON -> :
5990     * |   |       |   `--SLIST -> SLIST
5991     * |   |       |       `--LITERAL_YIELD -> yield
5992     * |   |       |           |--EXPR -> EXPR
5993     * |   |       |           |   `--NUM_INT -> 1
5994     * |   |       |           `--SEMI -> ;
5995     * |   |       |--CASE_GROUP -> CASE_GROUP
5996     * |   |       |   |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -> default
5997     * |   |       |   |   `--COLON -> :
5998     * |   |       |   `--SLIST -> SLIST
5999     * |   |       |       `--LITERAL_YIELD -> yield
6000     * |   |       |           |--EXPR -> EXPR
6001     * |   |       |           |   `--UNARY_MINUS -> -
6002     * |   |       |           |       `--NUM_INT -> 1
6003     * |   |       |           `--SEMI -> ;
6004     * |   |       `--RCURLY -> }
6005     * |   `--SEMI -> ;
6006     * }
6007     *
6008     *
6009     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6010     * @see #CASE_GROUP
6011     * @see #SLIST
6012     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
6013     *
6014     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se13/preview/switch-expressions.html">
6015     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;14.21</a>
6016     *
6017     * @since 8.36
6018     */
6019    public static final int LITERAL_YIELD =
6020            JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_YIELD;
6021
6022    /**
6023     * Switch Expressions.
6024     *
6025     * <p>For example:</p>
6026     * {@snippet :
6027     * return switch (day) {
6028     *     case SAT, SUN -> "Weekend";
6029     *     default -> "Working day";
6030     * };
6031     * }
6032     *
6033     * <p>parses as:</p>
6034     * {@snippet :
6035     * LITERAL_RETURN -> return
6036     *  |--EXPR -> EXPR
6037     *  |   `--LITERAL_SWITCH -> switch
6038     *  |       |--LPAREN -> (
6039     *  |       |--EXPR -> EXPR
6040     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> day
6041     *  |       |--RPAREN -> )
6042     *  |       |--LCURLY -> {
6043     *  |       |--SWITCH_RULE -> SWITCH_RULE
6044     *  |       |   |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
6045     *  |       |   |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
6046     *  |       |   |   |   `--IDENT -> SAT
6047     *  |       |   |   |--COMMA -> ,
6048     *  |       |   |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
6049     *  |       |   |       `--IDENT -> SUN
6050     *  |       |   |--LAMBDA -> ->
6051     *  |       |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
6052     *  |       |   |   `--STRING_LITERAL -> "Weekend"
6053     *  |       |   `--SEMI -> ;
6054     *  |       |--SWITCH_RULE -> SWITCH_RULE
6055     *  |       |   |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -> default
6056     *  |       |   |--LAMBDA -> ->
6057     *  |       |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
6058     *  |       |   |   `--STRING_LITERAL -> "Working day"
6059     *  |       |   `--SEMI -> ;
6060     *  |       `--RCURLY -> }
6061     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6062     * }
6063     *
6064     * @see #LITERAL_CASE
6065     * @see #LITERAL_DEFAULT
6066     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6067     * @see #LITERAL_YIELD
6068     *
6069     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se13/preview/switch-expressions.html">
6070     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;14.21</a>
6071     *
6072     * @since 8.36
6073     */
6074    public static final int SWITCH_RULE =
6075            JavaLanguageLexer.SWITCH_RULE;

6224    /**
6225     * A pattern definition, excluding simple type pattern (pattern variable)
6226     * definition such as {@code if (o instanceof Integer i){}}. Pattern definitions
6227     * appear as operands of statements and expressions.
6228     *

6230     * {@snippet :
6231     * switch(o) {
6232     *     case String s when s.length() > 4: // guarded pattern, `PATTERN_DEF`
6233     *         break;
6234     *     case String s: // type pattern, no `PATTERN_DEF`
6235     *         break;

6237     * }
6238     *
6239     * <p>parses as:</p>
6240     * {@snippet :
6241     * LITERAL_SWITCH -> switch
6242     *     |--LPAREN -> (
6243     *     |--EXPR -> EXPR
6244     *     |   `--IDENT -> o
6245     *     |--RPAREN -> )
6246     *     |--LCURLY -> {
6247     *     |--CASE_GROUP -> CASE_GROUP
6248     *     |   |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
6249     *     |   |   |--PATTERN_DEF -> PATTERN_DEF
6250     *     |   |   |   `--LITERAL_WHEN -> when
6251     *     |   |   |       |--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -> PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6252     *     |   |   |       |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
6253     *     |   |   |       |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
6254     *     |   |   |       |   |   `--IDENT -> String
6255     *     |   |   |       |   `--IDENT -> s
6256     *     |   |   |       `--GT -> >
6257     *     |   |   |           |--METHOD_CALL -> (
6258     *     |   |   |           |   |--DOT -> .
6259     *     |   |   |           |   |   |--IDENT -> s
6260     *     |   |   |           |   |   `--IDENT -> length
6261     *     |   |   |           |   |--ELIST -> ELIST
6262     *     |   |   |           |   `--RPAREN -> )
6263     *     |   |   |           `--NUM_INT -> 4
6264     *     |   |   `--COLON -> :
6265     *     |   `--SLIST -> SLIST
6266     *     |       `--LITERAL_BREAK -> break
6267     *     |           `--SEMI -> ;
6268     *     |--CASE_GROUP -> CASE_GROUP
6269     *     |   |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
6270     *     |   |   |--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -> PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6271     *     |   |   |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
6272     *     |   |   |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
6273     *     |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -> String
6274     *     |   |   |   `--IDENT -> s
6275     *     |   |   `--COLON -> :
6276     *     |   `--SLIST -> SLIST
6277     *     |       `--LITERAL_BREAK -> break
6278     *     |           `--SEMI -> ;
6279     *     `--RCURLY -> }
6280     * }
6281     *
6282     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se17/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.30">
6283     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;14.30</a>
6284     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6285     * @see #PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6286     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
6287     *
6288     * @since 9.3
6289     */
6290    public static final int PATTERN_DEF =
6291        JavaLanguageLexer.PATTERN_DEF;
6292
6293    /**
6294     * A {@code when} clause. Appears as part of a switch label in a guarded pattern definition.
6295     *
6296     * <p>For example:</p>
6297     * {@snippet :
6298     * return switch (o) {
6299     *     case Integer i when i >= 0 -> i;
6300     *     default -> 2;
6301     * };
6302     * }
6303     *
6304     * <p>parses as:</p>
6305     * {@snippet :
6306     * LITERAL_RETURN -> return
6307     *  `--EXPR -> EXPR
6308     *      `--LITERAL_SWITCH -> switch
6309     *          |--LPAREN -> (
6310     *          |--EXPR -> EXPR
6311     *          |   `--IDENT -> o
6312     *          |--RPAREN -> )
6313     *          |--LCURLY -> {
6314     *          |--SWITCH_RULE -> SWITCH_RULE
6315     *          |   |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
6316     *          |   |   `--PATTERN_DEF -> PATTERN_DEF
6317     *          |   |       `--LITERAL_WHEN -> when
6318     *          |   |           |--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -> PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6319     *          |   |           |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
6320     *          |   |           |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
6321     *          |   |           |   |   `--IDENT -> Integer
6322     *          |   |           |   `--IDENT -> i
6323     *          |   |           `--GE -> >=
6324     *          |   |               |--IDENT -> i
6325     *          |   |               `--NUM_INT -> 0
6326     *          |   |--LAMBDA -> ->
6327     *          |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
6328     *          |   |   `--IDENT -> i
6329     *          |   `--SEMI -> ;
6330     *          |--SWITCH_RULE -> SWITCH_RULE
6331     *          |   |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -> default
6332     *          |   |--LAMBDA -> ->
6333     *          |   |--EXPR -> EXPR
6334     *          |   |   `--NUM_INT -> 2
6335     *          |   `--SEMI -> ;
6336     *          `--RCURLY -> }
6337     * }
6338     *
6339     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se17/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.30">
6340     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;14.30</a>
6341     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6342     * @see #PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6343     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
6344     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
6345     *
6346     * @since 10.7.0
6347     */
6348    public static final int LITERAL_WHEN =
6349        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_WHEN;
6350
6351    /**
6352     * A {@code record} pattern definition. A record pattern consists of a type,
6353     * a (possibly empty) record component pattern list which is used to match against
6354     * the corresponding record components, and an optional identifier. Appears as part of
6355     * an {@code instanceof} expression or a {@code case} label in a switch.
6356     *
6357     * <p>For example:</p>
6358     * {@snippet :
6359     * if (o instanceof R(String s) myRecord) {}
6360     * }
6361     *
6362     * <p>parses as:</p>
6363     * {@snippet :
6364     * LITERAL_IF -> if
6365     *     |--LPAREN -> (
6366     *     |--EXPR -> EXPR
6367     *     |   `--LITERAL_INSTANCEOF -> instanceof
6368     *     |       |--IDENT -> o
6369     *     |       `--RECORD_PATTERN_DEF -> RECORD_PATTERN_DEF
6370     *     |           |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
6371     *     |           |--TYPE -> TYPE
6372     *     |           |   `--IDENT -> R
6373     *     |           |--LPAREN -> (
6374     *     |           |--RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS -> RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS
6375     *     |           |   `--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -> PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6376     *     |           |       |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
6377     *     |           |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
6378     *     |           |       |   `--IDENT -> String
6379     *     |           |       `--IDENT -> s
6380     *     |           |--RPAREN -> )
6381     *     |           `--IDENT -> myRecord
6382     *     |--RPAREN -> )
6383     *     `--SLIST -> {
6384     *         `--RCURLY -> }
6385     * }
6386     *
6387     * @see <a href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/405">JEP 405: Record Patterns</a>
6388     * @see #LITERAL_WHEN
6389     * @see #PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6390     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
6391     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
6392     *
6393     * @since 10.12.0
6394     */
6395    public static final int RECORD_PATTERN_DEF =
6396        JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_PATTERN_DEF;
6397
6398    /**
6399     * A (possibly empty) record component pattern list which is used to match against
6400     * the corresponding record components. Appears as part of a record pattern definition.
6401     *
6402     * <p>For example:</p>
6403     * {@snippet :
6404     * switch (o) {
6405     *     case R(String myComponent) when "component".equalsIgnoreCase(myComponent) -> {}
6406     * }
6407     * }
6408     *
6409     * <p>parses as:</p>
6410     * {@snippet :
6411     * LITERAL_SWITCH -> switch
6412     *     |--LPAREN -> (
6413     *     |--EXPR -> EXPR
6414     *     |   `--IDENT -> o
6415     *     |--RPAREN -> )
6416     *     |--LCURLY -> {
6417     *     |--SWITCH_RULE -> SWITCH_RULE
6418     *     |   |--LITERAL_CASE -> case
6419     *     |   |   `--PATTERN_DEF -> PATTERN_DEF
6420     *     |   |       `--LITERAL_WHEN -> when
6421     *     |   |           |--RECORD_PATTERN_DEF -> RECORD_PATTERN_DEF
6422     *     |   |           |   |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
6423     *     |   |           |   |--TYPE -> TYPE
6424     *     |   |           |   |   `--IDENT -> R
6425     *     |   |           |   |--LPAREN -> (
6426     *     |   |           |   |--RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS -> RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS
6427     *     |   |           |   |   `--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -> PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6428     *     |   |           |   |       |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
6429     *     |   |           |   |       |--TYPE -> TYPE
6430     *     |   |           |   |       |   `--IDENT -> String
6431     *     |   |           |   |       `--IDENT -> myComponent
6432     *     |   |           |   `--RPAREN -> )
6433     *     |   |           `--METHOD_CALL -> (
6434     *     |   |               |--DOT -> .
6435     *     |   |               |   |--STRING_LITERAL -> "component"
6436     *     |   |               |   `--IDENT -> equalsIgnoreCase
6437     *     |   |               |--ELIST -> ELIST
6438     *     |   |               |   `--EXPR -> EXPR
6439     *     |   |               |       `--IDENT -> myComponent
6440     *     |   |               `--RPAREN -> )
6441     *     |   |--LAMBDA -> ->
6442     *     |   `--SLIST -> {
6443     *     |       `--RCURLY -> }
6444     *     `--RCURLY -> }
6445     * }
6446     *
6447     * @see <a href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/405">JEP 405: Record Patterns</a>
6448     * @see #LITERAL_WHEN
6449     * @see #PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6450     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
6451     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
6452     *
6453     * @since 10.12.0
6454     */
6455    public static final int RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS =
6456            JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS;
6457
6458    /**
6459     * An unnamed pattern variable definition. Appears as part of a pattern definition.
6460     *
6461     * <p>For example:</p>
6462     * {@snippet :
6463     *    if (r instanceof R(_)) {}
6464     * }
6465     *
6466     * <p>parses as:</p>
6467     * {@snippet :
6468     * LITERAL_IF -> if
6469     *  |--LPAREN -> (
6470     *  |--EXPR -> EXPR
6471     *  |   `--LITERAL_INSTANCEOF -> instanceof
6472     *  |       |--IDENT -> r

6474     *  |           |--MODIFIERS -> MODIFIERS
6475     *  |           |--TYPE -> TYPE
6476     *  |           |   `--IDENT -> R
6477     *  |           |--LPAREN -> (
6478     *  |           |--RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS -> RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS
6479     *  |           |   `--UNNAMED_PATTERN_DEF -> _
6480     *  |           `--RPAREN -> )
6481     *  |--RPAREN -> )
6482     *  `--SLIST -> {
6483     *      `--RCURLY -> }
6484     * }
6485     *
6486     * @see #RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS
6487     * @see #RECORD_PATTERN_DEF
6488     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6489     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
6490     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
6491     * @see #LITERAL_WHEN
6492     * @see #PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6493     * @see #PATTERN_DEF
6494     *
6495     * @since 10.14.0
6496     */
6497    public static final int UNNAMED_PATTERN_DEF =
6498            JavaLanguageLexer.UNNAMED_PATTERN_DEF;

6500    /**

6520     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7">

6529    /**
6530     * A module import declaration - {@code import module}.

6534     * import module java.base;
6535     * }

6537     * <p>parses as:</p>
6538     * {@snippet :
6539     * MODULE_IMPORT -> import

6541     *  |--DOT -> .

6556    /**
6557     * An {@code open} keyword. This keyword marks a module declaration as open,
6558     * making all its packages available for deep reflection. It appears as a
6559     * child of {@link #MODULE_DEF}.

6562     * {@snippet :
6563     * open module com.example.app {
6564     * }
6565     * }

6568     * {@snippet :
6569     * MODULE_DEF -> MODULE_DEF
6570     *  |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
6571     *  |--LITERAL_OPEN -> open
6572     *  |--LITERAL_MODULE -> module
6573     *  |--DOT -> .
6574     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6575     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6576     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6577     *  |   `--IDENT -> app
6578     *  `--DIRECTIVE_BLOCK -> DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6579     *      |--LCURLY -> {
6580     *      `--RCURLY -> }
6581     * }

6591    /**
6592     * A {@code transitive} keyword. This keyword is a modifier of a
6593     * {@link #REQUIRES} directive and appears as a child of it.

6596     * {@snippet :
6597     * requires transitive java.sql;
6598     * }
6599     *
6600     * <p>parses as:</p>
6601     * {@snippet :
6602     * REQUIRES -> requires
6603     *  |--LITERAL_TRANSITIVE -> transitive
6604     *  |--DOT -> .
6605     *  |   |--IDENT -> java
6606     *  |   `--IDENT -> sql
6607     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6608     * }
6609     *
6610     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.1">
6611     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.1</a>

6615     */

6618    /**
6619     * A module declaration. The declaration of a Java Platform Module System

6621     * an {@link #ANNOTATIONS} node (which may be empty), an optional
6622     * {@link #LITERAL_OPEN}, a {@link #LITERAL_MODULE}, the module name, and
6623     * a {@link #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK}.
6624     *
6625     * <p>For example:</p>
6626     * {@snippet :
6627     * module com.example.app {
6628     *     requires java.base;
6629     * }
6630     * }

6633     * {@snippet :
6634     * COMPILATION_UNIT -> COMPILATION_UNIT
6635     *  `--MODULE_DEF -> MODULE_DEF
6636     *      |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
6637     *      |--LITERAL_MODULE -> module
6638     *      |--DOT -> .
6639     *      |   |--DOT -> .
6640     *      |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6641     *      |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6642     *      |   `--IDENT -> app
6643     *      `--DIRECTIVE_BLOCK -> DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6644     *          |--LCURLY -> {
6645     *          |--REQUIRES -> requires
6646     *          |   |--DOT -> .
6647     *          |   |   |--IDENT -> java
6648     *          |   |   `--IDENT -> base
6649     *          |   `--SEMI -> ;
6650     *          `--RCURLY -> }
6651     * }
6652     *
6653     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7">
6654     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7</a>
6655     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6656     * @see #LITERAL_MODULE
6657     * @see #LITERAL_OPEN
6658     * @see #ANNOTATIONS
6659     *
6660     * @since 14.0.0
6661     */
6662    public static final int MODULE_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.MODULE_DEF;

6664    /**
6665     * A directive block. The braced body of a module declaration, containing
6666     * zero or more module directives. It is a child of {@link #MODULE_DEF}.
6667     *
6668     * <p>For example:</p>
6669     * {@snippet :
6670     * module com.example.app {
6671     *     uses com.example.api.Service;
6672     * }
6673     * }

6675     * <p>parses as:</p>
6676     * {@snippet :
6677     * MODULE_DEF -> MODULE_DEF
6678     *  |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
6679     *  |--LITERAL_MODULE -> module
6680     *  |--DOT -> .
6681     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6682     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6683     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6684     *  |   `--IDENT -> app
6685     *  `--DIRECTIVE_BLOCK -> DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6686     *      |--LCURLY -> {
6687     *      |--USES -> uses
6688     *      |   |--DOT -> .
6689     *      |   |   |--DOT -> .
6690     *      |   |   |   |--DOT -> .
6691     *      |   |   |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6692     *      |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6693     *      |   |   |   `--IDENT -> api
6694     *      |   |   `--IDENT -> Service
6695     *      |   `--SEMI -> ;
6696     *      `--RCURLY -> }
6697     * }
6698     *
6699     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7">
6700     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7</a>
6701     * @see #MODULE_DEF
6702     *
6703     * @since 14.0.0
6704     */
6705    public static final int DIRECTIVE_BLOCK = JavaLanguageLexer.DIRECTIVE_BLOCK;

6707    /**
6708     * A requires directive. Declares a dependence of the current module on
6709     * another module. Its children are optional {@link #LITERAL_TRANSITIVE}
6710     * or {@link #LITERAL_STATIC} modifiers, the name of the required module,
6711     * and a semicolon.

6714     * {@snippet :
6715     * requires transitive java.sql;
6716     * }
6717     *
6718     * <p>parses as:</p>
6719     * {@snippet :
6720     * REQUIRES -> requires
6721     *  |--LITERAL_TRANSITIVE -> transitive
6722     *  |--DOT -> .
6723     *  |   |--IDENT -> java
6724     *  |   `--IDENT -> sql
6725     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6726     * }
6727     *
6728     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.1">
6729     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.1</a>
6730     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6731     * @see #LITERAL_TRANSITIVE
6732     * @see #LITERAL_STATIC
6733     *
6734     * @since 14.0.0
6735     */
6736    public static final int REQUIRES = JavaLanguageLexer.REQUIRES;

6738    /**
6739     * An exports directive. Makes a package of the current module accessible
6740     * to other modules. Its children are the exported package name, an
6741     * optional {@link #TO} clause, and a semicolon.
6742     *

6744     * {@snippet :
6745     * exports com.example.api to com.example.one, com.example.two;
6746     * }

6748     * <p>parses as:</p>
6749     * {@snippet :
6750     * EXPORTS -> exports
6751     *  |--DOT -> .
6752     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6753     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6754     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6755     *  |   `--IDENT -> api
6756     *  |--TO -> to
6757     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6758     *  |   |   |--DOT -> .
6759     *  |   |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6760     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6761     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> one
6762     *  |   |--COMMA -> ,
6763     *  |   `--DOT -> .
6764     *  |       |--DOT -> .
6765     *  |       |   |--IDENT -> com
6766     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> example
6767     *  |       `--IDENT -> two
6768     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6769     * }
6770     *
6771     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.2">
6772     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.2</a>
6773     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6774     * @see #TO
6775     *
6776     * @since 14.0.0
6777     */
6778    public static final int EXPORTS = JavaLanguageLexer.EXPORTS;
6779
6780    /**
6781     * An opens directive. Makes a package of the current module available for
6782     * deep reflection to other modules. Its children are the opened package
6783     * name, an optional {@link #TO} clause, and a semicolon.
6784     *
6785     * <p>For example:</p>
6786     * {@snippet :
6787     * opens com.example.model;
6788     * }
6789     *
6790     * <p>parses as:</p>
6791     * {@snippet :
6792     * OPENS -> opens
6793     *  |--DOT -> .
6794     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6795     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6796     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6797     *  |   `--IDENT -> model
6798     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6799     * }
6800     *
6801     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.2">
6802     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.2</a>
6803     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6804     * @see #TO
6805     *
6806     * @since 14.0.0
6807     */
6808    public static final int OPENS = JavaLanguageLexer.OPENS;
6809
6810    /**
6811     * A uses directive. Declares a service whose implementations the current
6812     * module discovers via {@code java.util.ServiceLoader}. Its children are
6813     * the service type name and a semicolon.
6814     *
6815     * <p>For example:</p>
6816     * {@snippet :
6817     * uses com.example.api.Service;
6818     * }
6819     *
6820     * <p>parses as:</p>
6821     * {@snippet :
6822     * USES -> uses
6823     *  |--DOT -> .
6824     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6825     *  |   |   |--DOT -> .
6826     *  |   |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6827     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6828     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> api
6829     *  |   `--IDENT -> Service
6830     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6831     * }
6832     *
6833     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.3">
6834     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.3</a>
6835     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6836     *
6837     * @since 14.0.0
6838     */
6839    public static final int USES = JavaLanguageLexer.USES;
6840
6841    /**
6842     * A provides directive. Declares implementations of a service that the
6843     * current module supplies. Its children are the service type name, a
6844     * {@link #WITH} clause, and a semicolon.
6845     *
6846     * <p>For example:</p>
6847     * {@snippet :
6848     * provides com.example.Service with com.example.Impl;
6849     * }
6850     *
6851     * <p>parses as:</p>
6852     * {@snippet :
6853     * PROVIDES -> provides
6854     *  |--DOT -> .
6855     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6856     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6857     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6858     *  |   `--IDENT -> Service
6859     *  |--WITH -> with
6860     *  |   `--DOT -> .
6861     *  |       |--DOT -> .
6862     *  |       |   |--IDENT -> com
6863     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> example
6864     *  |       `--IDENT -> Impl
6865     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6866     * }
6867     *
6868     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.4">
6869     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.4</a>
6870     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6871     * @see #WITH
6872     *
6873     * @since 14.0.0
6874     */
6875    public static final int PROVIDES = JavaLanguageLexer.PROVIDES;
6876
6877    /**
6878     * A to clause. Limits an {@link #EXPORTS} or {@link #OPENS} directive to
6879     * the named friend modules. Its children are the module names, separated by commas.
6880     *
6881     * <p>For example:</p>
6882     * {@snippet :
6883     * opens com.example.secrets to com.example.friend;
6884     * }
6885     *
6886     * <p>parses as:</p>
6887     * {@snippet :
6888     * OPENS -> opens
6889     *  |--DOT -> .
6890     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6891     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6892     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6893     *  |   `--IDENT -> secrets
6894     *  |--TO -> to
6895     *  |   `--DOT -> .
6896     *  |       |--DOT -> .
6897     *  |       |   |--IDENT -> com
6898     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> example
6899     *  |       `--IDENT -> friend
6900     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6901     * }
6902     *
6903     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.2">
6904     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.2</a>
6905     * @see #EXPORTS
6906     * @see #OPENS
6907     *
6908     * @since 14.0.0
6909     */
6910    public static final int TO = JavaLanguageLexer.TO;
6911
6912    /**
6913     * A with clause. Names the implementation types supplied by a
6914     * {@link #PROVIDES} directive. Its children are the implementation type
6915     * names, separated by commas.
6916     *
6917     * <p>For example:</p>
6918     * {@snippet :
6919     * provides com.example.Service with com.example.Impl;
6920     * }
6921     *
6922     * <p>parses as:</p>
6923     * {@snippet :
6924     * PROVIDES -> provides
6925     *  |--DOT -> .
6926     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6927     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6928     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6929     *  |   `--IDENT -> Service
6930     *  |--WITH -> with
6931     *  |   `--DOT -> .
6932     *  |       |--DOT -> .
6933     *  |       |   |--IDENT -> com
6934     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> example
6935     *  |       `--IDENT -> Impl
6936     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6937     * }
6938     *
6939     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.4">
6940     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.4</a>
6941     * @see #PROVIDES
6942     *
6943     * @since 14.0.0
6944     */
6945    public static final int WITH = JavaLanguageLexer.WITH;
